title: Check Out the Daily Schedule For BillboardTV
summary: The team-up with Samsung TV Plus brings a 24/7 streaming destination for music culture, news and live events.
contentText:
BillboardTV , a collaboration between Billboard and Samsung TV Plus, features a variety of shows focused on some of Billboard ‘s most exciting editorial franchises, including Chart History, Takes Us Out, On the Record and In Conversation.

The exclusive free streaming channel available now on Samsung TV Plus and Amazon’s Fire TV is packed with nonstop updates from Billboard News, as well as never-before-seen interviews, red carpet coverage, live concert specials and deep-dive documentary-style profiles of artists through their own eyes.

Among the series fans can tune into now in two-hour blocks is On the Record, a weekly show featuring unfiltered conversations with executives, artists and innovators shaping the music industry hosted by Billboard Senior Correspondent Kristin Robinson. Previous episodes have included chats with John Summit, FINNEAS and Charlie Puth, in conversations where they break down the pipeline from boardroom decisions to the music that fans stream, buy and listen to live.

Chart History takes a look at the artists behind the Hot 100 chart’s biggest hits, with acts including Snoop Dogg, Ciara and Mariah Carey breaking down the songs and videos that defined their careers in candid conversations featuring never-before-heard stories, memories and behind-the-scenes moments chronicling the chart-topping records that made music history.

The popular Takes Us Out series invites viewers along as artists such as KATSEYE, Yungblud and Addison Rae grab a meal and chat about their music and life in a super-relaxed setting, while the Billboard News Interview serves up newsworthy chats with the biggest artists on the charts and Billboard journalists in a fast-paced, fun setting.

You can also check out the more in-depth, premium Billboard Cover Interview series, a visual companion to the magazine’s cover stories, with verité, structured sit-downs and cinematic portraits shot on set with acts including Mick Jagger and Keith Richards, Riley Green and Kehlani. Other series now available include In Conversation, in which music’s biggest stars sit down with Billboard ‘s editorial team for candid chats about the defining moments in their careers; and Billboard Presents, an Emmy-nominated docu-style profile of artists through their own eyes, in which stars such as A$AP Rocky, Cardi B and Fuerza Regida pull back the curtain on their music and lives in a never-before-seen fashion.

The daily schedule is as follows:

8 a.m. PT: Billboard On the Record

10 a.m. PT: Billboard Chart History

12 p.m. PT: Takes Us Out

2 p.m. PT: Billboard News Interview

4 p.m. PT: Billboard Cover Interview

6 p.m. PT: In Conversation

8 p.m. PT: Billboard Presents
